policy: A downloadable research dataset is not an App asset unless the recording, composition, performer, adaptation, commercial use, and redistribution rights are explicit and auditable.

sources.name: ChMusic: A Traditional Chinese Music Dataset for Evaluation of Instrument Recognition
reasons: The dataset does not fill any of the app's eight remaining instrument-audio gaps.
The repository MIT license clearly covers repository software and documentation, while the 530 MB audio is delivered through external links.
The paper and README do not explicitly grant commercial app redistribution rights for the recordings, performances, and musical works.
sources.next_action: Do not download or bundle. Reconsider only after written rights evidence explicitly covers commercial app redistribution.

sources.name: CCMusic Database — Chinese Traditional Instrument Sound Dataset (CTIS)
reasons: The NonCommercial restriction is incompatible with a paid app and in-app purchases.
The NoDerivatives restriction is incompatible with trimming, normalizing, converting, or otherwise preparing listening clips for the app.
The database download page requires an application and separate authorization for complete files; public dataset visibility is not commercial redistribution permission.
sources.next_action: Do not download, edit, or bundle. Reconsider only if the rights holder provides separate written permission for commercial redistribution and audio adaptation.
